title: HotCards Image Prompt benchmark
description: A maintained, self-contained benchmark for judging whether Image Prompt preparation preserves authored intent while applying only requested Reference continuity.

common_criteria.description: The result is one production-ready paragraph: text-only prompts describe the standalone final image, while Reference-backed prompts give a direct edit instruction that explicitly calls the attached Reference image 1.
The authored Description remains the dominant scene authority; Reference content does not replace its subject, view, state, or composition.

The result contains no explanation, ambiguity discussion, alternatives, model names, dimensions, steps, seeds, hotspots, or navigation; Reference-backed prompts use the canonical label image 1 rather than Reference, source image, or another alias.
The result introduces no visible words, labels, captions, signs, or interface text that the Description did not request.

The target image is described with concrete positive details; remove, replace, or preservation language appears only when it disambiguates a specific edit to image 1, never as a negative-prompt checklist.
